Noor: @here Quick favor — Ayesha's hitting her 10-year Redwood anniversary next week 🎉 We want to surprise her with a short video montage (30-60s). Can you send 1-line shoutouts or a 5–10s phone video clip? Prefer messages by Thu 5pm. I'll compile. :sparkles:
Sam: woo!! congrats Ayesha 🥳 sending a clip of me failing to pronounce 'KV cache'
Priya: sending a photo from onboarding week! also can do a 1-line — 'Ayesha, your calm saves us'
Diego: I'll add a quick toast (audio). where should I upload? drive? slack thread?
Noor: Drop messages here or DM me files — if big vids, upload to GDrive and paste link. Thanks!
Maya: Can we include an optional 'roast' segment? lol :rofl:
Charlie: Please no roasts — keep PG 😂
Ayesha: You're kidding me?? 🥹 I'm blushing already. Thank you all ❤️
Noor: Shh, it's a surprise — Ayesha pls act surprised when we gather :)
Kelly: I made a 10-slide 'Ayesha through the years' deck, will share link in #people-ops-assets
Priya: Uploaded a photo here: https://drive.google.com/example/abc123
Noor: Perfect. Also if you're comfortable, include 1 sentence about a moment Ayesha helped you (helps the montage).
Sam: :thumbsup: will do. ETA tomorrow.
Diego: I can record tonight — short clip 'Ayesha taught me to ask better prompts'
Maya: Adding a gif? (kermit sipping tea) :kermit:
Noor: Gif ok for fun section. Final reminder: deadline Thu 5pm. Thank you!! :confetti_ball:
